occurrence_evidence.claim: On 15 June at 21:23, OpenAI identified elevated errors in FedRAMP workspaces and API organisations and said mitigation was being prepared.
It continued investigation at 22:16 on 15 June, 01:24 on 17 June and 19:41 on 18 June. The notice gives no per-function or customer breakdown.
At 23:07 on 26 June it reported all impacted services recovered. The page gives no timezone or technical cause.
